visual.general_description: Photograph of a printed multi-lead electrocardiogram on gridded paper, with lead labels and device text along the lower edge.
visual.detailed_description: Color photograph of a gridded ECG printout with black tracings in three rows of lead segments plus one long bottom row labeled V1 at the left. Lead labels printed beside the tracings include I, II, III, aVR, aVL, aVF, V1, V2, V3, V4, V5 and V6 (the top-left label is hard to read). Most segments show large, closely spaced, regular up-and-down oscillations of similar shape; the segments labeled V4 to V6 show smaller, narrower complexes. In the left three rows several segments contain a flat horizontal line stretch between oscillations. The lower edge of the paper carries printed device and software text, a paper speed of 25 mm/s, a gain of 10 mm/mV, filter settings and a status label, with a page indicator at the lower right. No patient name, identifier number or date is visible. The paper edges and grid show some uneven lighting from the photograph.

visual.general_description: Grayscale cardiac cine still frame with a red measurement line and a "6mm" label.
visual.detailed_description: Portrait grayscale magnetic resonance still frame with a black background and bright blood-filled chambers separated by thin dark walls. At the center of the frame two large elongated bright chambers lie side by side, with smaller round bright structures above and to the right and a ring-shaped structure at the upper right. A red diagonal line runs from the middle of the dividing dark wall down and to the right, and a short red perpendicular line segment near its lower end points to a small notch at the lower edge of the bright chamber. The white printed label "6mm" sits beside this short segment. No patient name, identifier, date or scanner text is visible. The edges of the frame show curved dark and bright bands.
